exposure: Gestational age at GDM diagnosis (<24 weeks vs ≥24 weeks)
Glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) levels at diagnosis of gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM)
cohort: 3098 pregnant women with GDM at the Royal Prince Alfred Hospital Diabetes Antenatal Clinic, Australia, between 1991 and 2011
finding: In women with GDM diagnosed at ≥24 weeks' gestation, HbA1c >5.9% (41 mmol/mol) was associated with an increased risk of large-for-gestational-age, macrosomia, cesarean section, and hypertensive disorders.
